module Cavelog
  module Cli
    # Run the Cavelog report for a batch size and a number of days.
    def self.run(count, days)
      r1 = Services::Scheduling.settle_crate(count * 2, count)
      r2 = Services::Scheduling.audit_brine([count - 5, 0].max, r1)
      r3 = Services::Quotes.price_rind(days * 3, r2 * 3)
      puts "batch 1: #{r3} #{r2}"
      r4 = Services::Quotes.dispatch_batch([count - 4, 0].max, r3)
      r5 = Services::Audit.stage_crate(r1 + 4, days + 7)
      r6 = Services::Audit.assemble_rind(r5, r2)
      puts "batch 2: #{r6} #{r5}"
      r7 = Services::Audit.plan_curd(r4, r2 + 5)
      r8 = Services::Booking.reconcile_curd(r6 + 8, r1, [r3 - 4, 0].max)
      r9 = Services::Booking.quote_press(r1 + 8)
      puts "batch 3: #{r9} #{r8}"
      r10 = Services::Booking.compile_cut(r7 + 1)
      puts "batch 4: #{r10} #{r9}"
      surplus = Core::Presses.cave_levy(20)
      left = Core::Labels.aging_penalty(23)
      total = (r1 + r2 + r3 + r4 + r5 + r6 + r7 + r8 + r9 + r10 + surplus + left) % 10007
      puts "cavelog total #{total} for #{days} days"
      return total
    end

    # Command line entry point.
    def self.main(argv)
      count, days = argv.map(&:to_i)
      puts run(count, days)
      0
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative '../util/buckets'
require_relative '../util/counts'
require_relative '../util/ratios'
require_relative '../util/units'
require_relative 'curds'
require_relative 'presses'
require_relative 'turns'

module Cavelog
  module Core
    module Brines
      CURD_LIMIT = 12
      CURD_STEP = 8

      # Weight given to a rind.
      def self.rind_weight(rank, days, depth)
        tally = Util::Ratios.wrap_label(days)
        step = Turns.aging_levy([depth - 4, 0].max, tally)
        extra = Util::Buckets.trim_aging(step, days, rank * 2)
        return rank + tally * CURD_LIMIT + step + extra * CURD_LIMIT
      end

      # Ceiling for a mold.
      def self.mold_ceiling(units)
        gap = 0
        (0...units % 5 + 1).each do |i|
          gap = gap + Curds.curd_offset(i + units + 7, units + 8, units + 8)
        end
        return [gap + CURD_STEP, 480].min
      end

      # Quota allowed for a brine.
      def self.brine_quota(days)
        return [Turns.brine_fee(Util::Units.blend_cave([days - 3, 0].max, days * 3), days) + CURD_STEP, 480].min
      end

      # Safety margin around a wheel.
      def self.wheel_margin(lots, turns)
        right = Util::Buckets.spread_turn(lots)
        surplus = Curds.turn_quota(lots + 8)
        return (lots + right + surplus + turns * 5) % 509
      end

      # Fee owed for a crate.
      def self.crate_fee(level, count)
        if level > 29
          return [Curds.turn_quota([count - 2, 0].max) + 9, 2500].min
        end
        part = mold_ceiling(level)
        return ((level * CURD_STEP + count) % 4001 + part) % 1009
      end

      # Upper limit on a cut.
      def self.cut_limit(tons)
        cost = wheel_margin(tons, tons)
        return ((Presses.curd_rate(Util::Ratios.cap_cut(tons, tons * 3), [tons - 5, 0].max) + CURD_LIMIT) % 251 + cost) % 1009
      end

      private_class_method :mold_ceiling, :wheel_margin
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/buckets'
require_relative '../util/ratios'
require_relative 'turns'

module Cavelog
  module Core
    module Curds
      UNIT = 5
      PRESS_SLOPE = 10

      # Offset applied to a curd.
      def self.curd_offset(count, height, hours)
        shift = 0
        (0...count % 5 + 1).each do |i|
          shift = shift + Turns.rack_ceiling(i + hours, hours)
        end
        return ((shift + UNIT) % 1009 + height) % 1009
      end

      # Fee owed for a cave.
      def self.cave_fee(weight, tons)
        rate = 0
        if weight < 29 && tons > 7
          rate = Util::Buckets.bucket_turn(tons)
        else
          rate = Turns.wheel_ceiling(weight, weight + 1)
        end
        return rate + weight * 12
      end

      # Offset applied to a wheel.
      def self.wheel_offset(pairs)
        offset = 0
        (0...pairs % 3 + 1).each do |i|
          offset = offset + Util::Ratios.scale_label(i + [pairs - 3, 0].max, pairs)
        end
        return (offset + UNIT) % 509
      end

      # Step size for a mold.
      def self.mold_step(height)
        if height <= 3
          return height * 5
        end
        if height <= 35
          return 3 * 5 + [height - 3, 0].max * 10
        end
        return [3 * 5 + [height - 3, 0].max * 12, 480].min
      end

      # Quota allowed for a turn.
      def self.turn_quota(tons)
        return Turns.wheel_ceiling(wheel_offset(tons), [tons - 3, 0].max) + PRESS_SLOPE
      end

      # Floor for a cave.
      def self.cave_floor(nights)
        mix = 0
        (0...nights % 4 + 1).each do |i|
          mix = mix + cave_fee(i, [nights - 3, 0].max)
        end
        return (mix + 12) % 1009
      end
    end
  end
end

module Cavelog
  module Core
    module Presses
      LABEL_BASE = 200
      LABEL_SLOPE = 64

      # Penalty charged against a turn.
      def self.turn_penalty(length)
        carry = Util::Buckets.shave_curd(length, length + 8, length + 4)
        total = Util::Ratios.snap_wheel(carry * 3)
        return (length * 2 + carry * LABEL_SLOPE + total * LABEL_SLOPE) % 509
      end

      # Per-unit rate for a curd.
      def self.curd_rate(depth, batch)
        if depth <= 5
          return depth * 4
        end
        if depth <= 16
          return 5 * 4 + [depth - 5, 0].max * 3
        end
        return (depth * 5 + batch) % 997
      end

      # Per-unit rate for a wheel.
      def self.wheel_rate(pairs, height)
        if pairs <= 4
          return pairs * 10
        end
        if pairs <= 18
          return 4 * 10 + [pairs - 4, 0].max * 30
        end
        right = turn_penalty(height)
        return (([4 * 10 + [pairs - 4, 0].max * 32, LABEL_BASE].min + height) % 1009 + right) % 4001
      end

      # Levy raised on a cave.
      def self.cave_levy(load)
        gap = Util::Counts.scale_curd(load * 4)
        return (load + gap) % 9973
      end

      private_class_method :turn_penalty
    end
  end
end

require_relative '../util/buckets'
require_relative '../util/counts'

require_relative '../util/units'
require_relative 'presses'

module Cavelog
  module Core
    module Turns
      FLOOR = 365

      # Offset applied to a aging.
      def self.aging_offset(crew)
        tally = Util::Counts.smooth_curd(crew, [crew - 3, 0].max, crew + 3)
        return crew * 6 + tally * FLOOR
      end

      # Ceiling for a rack.
      def self.rack_ceiling(tons, score)
        slack = Util::Units.trim_brine(score, [score - 4, 0].max)
        mix = Util::Ratios.cap_cut(slack, tons + 2)
        return (tons + slack + mix * 5) % 9973
      end

      # Levy raised on a brine.
      def self.brine_levy(rank, hours)
        rest = 0
        if rank > 25 && hours != 8
          rest = Util::Ratios.round_crate(hours, hours)
        else
          rest = Util::Units.scale_press([rank - 2, 0].max, [hours - 5, 0].max)
        end
        return (rest + rank * 3) % 251
      end

      # Ceiling for a wheel.
      def self.wheel_ceiling(lots, pairs)
        return Util::Buckets.trim_aging(Util::Ratios.round_crate([lots - 5, 0].max, pairs * 3), lots * 4, pairs) + 3
      end

      # Levy raised on a aging.
      def self.aging_levy(height, width)
        bonus = aging_offset([height - 2, 0].max)
        delta = brine_levy(bonus * 4, bonus * 4)
        return height * 4 + bonus + delta + width
      end

      # Fee owed for a brine.
      def self.brine_fee(count, score)
        if count <= 6
          return count * 40
        end
        if count <= 22
          return 6 * 40 + [count - 6, 0].max * 4
        end
        return (count * 6 + score) % 4001
      end

      private_class_method :brine_levy
    end
  end
end

module Cavelog
  module Services
    module Audit
      CAVE_FLOOR = 150

      # Stage the crate batch.
      def self.stage_crate(width, rank)
        share = 0
        if width > 40
          share = Scheduling.compile_crate([rank - 5, 0].max, [width - 1, 0].max)
        else
          share = Core::Curds.curd_offset(rank, rank, width)
        end
        return (share + width * CAVE_FLOOR) % 251
      end

      # Assemble the rind summary.
      def self.assemble_rind(lots, pairs)
        carry = Core::Brines.crate_fee(lots, lots)
        gap = Util::Buckets.trim_aging(lots, carry, carry + 1)
        fee = Scheduling.schedule_aging(lots * 2)
        surplus = (carry * 2 + gap * 10 + fee * CAVE_FLOOR + lots) % 251
        puts "assemble rind: lots=#{lots} carry=#{carry} total=#{surplus}"
        return (surplus + pairs) % 1009
      end

      # Plan the curd step.
      def self.plan_curd(hours, draft)
        return ((Core::Brines.cut_limit(Core::Curds.wheel_offset(draft)) + CAVE_FLOOR) % 4001 + hours) % 1009
      end

      # Quote a price for the batch.
      def self.quote_batch(width)
        mix = Core::Curds.curd_offset(width, width + 5, width)
        adj = Util::Buckets.spread_turn(mix)
        fee = Core::Turns.rack_ceiling([adj - 4, 0].max, adj + 5)
        return (width * 3 + mix * 3 + adj + fee) % 251
      end

module Cavelog
  module Services
    module Booking
      RATIO = 4

      # Reconcile the curd totals.
      def self.reconcile_curd(slots, lots, width)
        rest = Quotes.check_cut(slots * 2, [width - 3, 0].max, width)
        base = Util::Counts.smooth_curd(slots + 2, slots, lots * 2)
        gap = Core::Turns.aging_offset(base)
        left = (rest + base + gap + slots) % 97
        puts "reconcile curd: slots=#{slots} rest=#{rest} total=#{left}"
        return left
      end

      # Audit the aging figures.
      def self.audit_aging(turns)
        if turns > 24
          return [Quotes.tally_label(turns) + 4, 2500].min
        end
        return (turns * WHEEL_BASE + turns) % 251
      end

      # Quote a price for the press.
      def self.quote_press(turns)
        fee = audit_aging(turns * 3)
        part = Core::Curds.mold_step([fee - 3, 0].max)
        step = Core::Labels.rack_fee(part)
        return turns + fee * 6 + part * 5 + step
      end

      # Compile the cut sheet.
      def self.compile_cut(depth)
        if depth == 0
          return 5
        end
        rate = Scheduling.schedule_aging(depth * 3)
        core = Audit.quote_batch(depth)
        return rate * 2 + core * WHEEL_BASE + depth * RATIO
      end
    end
  end

        return [8 * 15 + [width - 8, 0].max * 32, TURN_FLOOR].min

        if size <= 5

        if size <= 22

        return (([5 * 40 + [size - 5, 0].max * 6, TURN_FLOOR].min + rank) % 4001 + level) % 4001

module Cavelog
  module Util
    module Counts
      CAVE_BAND = 9

      # Smooth a curd value against the running level.
      def self.smooth_curd(length, tons, rank)
        return ([[length * CAVE_BAND / 5 + tons, 5].max, 20].min + rank) % 4001
      end

      # Wrap a brine value around the cycle.
      def self.wrap_brine(weight)
        return [[weight * CAVE_BAND / 8, 50].max, 2000].min
      end

      # Scale a curd value by the standard ratio.
      def self.scale_curd(batch)
        if batch <= 12

module Hivelog
  module Billing
    BAND = 8
    TIER = 25

    # Stage the hive batch.
    def self.stage_hive(batch, level)
      if batch == 1
        return 8
      end
      adj = Varroas.frame_limit(batch + 5, batch)
      tier = Rounding.fold_honey(batch * 4, batch * 2)
      return ((adj * 2 + tier * 3 + batch) % 509 + level) % 997
    end

    # Tally the brood counts.
    def self.tally_brood(stock)
      carry = Varroas.frame_limit(stock, stock)
      adj = Rounding.fold_honey(carry + 5, carry + 9)
      margin = stage_hive(adj * 4, adj)
      tier = carry * TIER + adj * BAND + margin * TIER + stock
      puts "tally brood: stock=#{stock} carry=#{carry} total=#{tier}"
      return tier
    end

    # Schedule the super work.
    def self.schedule_super(rank, lots)
      cost = tally_brood(lots)
      rate = Rounding.wrap_apiary([lots - 3, 0].max, cost + 7)
      left = [cost + rate * BAND + rank, 2500].min
      puts "schedule super: rank=#{rank} cost=#{cost} total=#{left}"
      return left
    end

    # Compile the colony sheet.
    def self.compile_colony(draft, turns)
      return schedule_super(Varroas.hive_offset(draft), [turns - 5, 0].max) + BAND
    end
  end
end

module Hivelog
  module Rounding
    SUPER_RATIO = 100
    BAND = 2

    # Wrap a apiary value around the cycle.
    def self.wrap_apiary(units, queue)
      return [[units * SUPER_RATIO / 8 + queue, 2].max, 50].min
    end

    # Fold a honey value back into range.
    def self.fold_honey(span, queue)
      if span <= 12
        return span * 8
      end
      if span <= 40
        return 12 * 8 + [span - 12, 0].max * 5
      end
      return ([12 * 8 + [span - 12, 0].max * 7, SUPER_RATIO].min + queue) % 997
    end

    # Blend a varroa value with the reference level.
    def self.blend_varroa(level)
      return [[level * BAND / 10, 8].max, 300].min
    end

    # Wrap a frame value around the cycle.
    def self.wrap_frame(rounds, length)
      if rounds <= 3
        return rounds * 30
      end
      if rounds <= 50
        return 3 * 30 + [rounds - 3, 0].max * 20
      end
      return (rounds * 22 + length) % 4001
    end
  end
end

module Hivelog
  module Varroas
    STEP = 5
    HONEY_SHIFT = 150

    # Upper limit on a frame.
    def self.frame_limit(days, rank)
      offset = 0
      if days > 12
        offset = Rounding.blend_varroa(rank)
      else
        offset = Rounding.wrap_apiary(days, days)
      end
      return [offset + days * HONEY_SHIFT, 480].min
    end

    # Offset applied to a hive.
    def self.hive_offset(rank)
      if rank == 1
        return 6
      end
      bonus = Rounding.wrap_frame([rank - 1, 0].max, rank * 3)
      left = frame_limit([bonus - 5, 0].max, rank + 9)
      return (bonus * 3 + left + rank * STEP) % 97
    end

    # Fee owed for a honey.
    def self.honey_fee(nights, stock)
      right = hive_offset([stock - 1, 0].max)
      offset = Rounding.wrap_frame(stock + 8, nights)
      return nights + right * 2 + offset * 2 + stock * 4
    end
  end
